title: Manual payments
help: Review private payment receipts and credit the customer's wallet after verifying payment. Bank matching and automatic approval are not connected yet.
settingsHelp: Changes apply to new invoices immediately. Existing invoices keep their original destination, instructions and file limit. Disabling new invoices leaves existing invoices available for review.
issueHelp: Open a rial wallet, configure the receiving account and issue an invoice. Manual payments have no matching surcharge or identifier.
snapshotHelp: The displayed destination and amount were recorded when this invoice was issued. Only its base amount is credited after approval.
reviewHelp: Verify the transfer in the receiving account first. A receipt file alone does not prove payment. Record why you approved or rejected it; rejected unsettled invoices can be reviewed again.
